title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — Jun 5, 2026
summary: Africa CDC and WHO jointly launched a $518 million Continental Preparedness and Response Plan on June 5 — the largest African-institution-led outbreak mobilization in history — targeting 54 African countries with a focus on 12 high-risk DRC-Uganda neighbors. The plan follows confirmed DRC cases reaching 363 (341 Ituri across 17 health zones, 19 Nord-Kivu, 3 Sud-Kivu) plus 15 Uganda for a global total of 378 confirmed cases and 63 deaths as of June 3. WHO DG Tedros on June 3 called the response 'catching up' while noting contact tracing coverage at ~45% remains critically below the 90% threshold needed for containment. KPIs, casualties, economic data, political figures, map points, and events for June 3 and June 5 have been updated.
